## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature (minor release)
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (patch release)
- [ ] `docs` / `chore` / `test` / `refactor` / `ci` — no release
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` in the title or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer — major release)

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `npm run preflight` passes locally (lint, typecheck, 100%-coverage tests, build)
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] Tests were added/updated for every new code path
- [ ] Docs were updated if behaviour changed (`README.md`, `docs/docs.html`)
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies, and no Node-only APIs in `src/`
